articles.title: JPMorgan, HSBC and StoneX complete first digital gold trades in London
articles.snippet: The banks tested a new way to trade fractions of physical gold bars and use the metal as collateral without moving it from vaults for the first time.

articles.title: Elon Musk’s X Wins Court Judgment Against Alleged Bitcoin Bot Farm Operators
articles.snippet: London’s High Court entered a default judgment against Vivek Kumar Sen and Zamyang Sherpa after they failed to respond, though damages, which X estimates at over £207,000, won’t be set until a later hearing.
